name: Lotusa Price Campaigns for WooCommerce
author: Simeon

sections.description:
Lotusa Price Campaigns for WooCommerce helps store owners update product prices in controlled AJAX batches without editing products one by one.

Before changing a product, the plugin stores its previous regular price, sale price, and sale dates. An eligible campaign can later be restored from Campaign History.

Free features

  • Increase or decrease regular prices by a percentage.
  • Create or replace sale prices with a percentage discount.
  • Choose one or more product categories from a hierarchical category tree; parent categories automatically include descendants.
  • Load the current category selection before changing prices and reload it when the scope changes.
  • Preview the exact price changes before the live campaign can start.
  • Process simple products and individual variations.
  • Follow progress through an AJAX progress bar and live log.
  • Store product-level before/after values and restore campaigns manually.
  • Synchronize variable parents and clear relevant WooCommerce caches.

The free plugin includes hierarchical category selection, safe Load/Reload workflow, preview-before-apply, percentage campaigns, variation processing, history, and undo. The separately distributed Pro package adds individual variation pricing, advanced targeting, additional pricing methods, scheduling, rounding, price-ending normalization, and reports.

Upgrade to Pro: https://checkout.freemius.com/plugin/36571/plan/60548/

Safety notes

  • Make a complete database backup before the first large campaign.
  • Test the first campaign on a staging copy whenever possible.
  • Wait for a campaign to finish before starting another price campaign.
  • Review skipped and failed products in the live log.
  • Before restoring an older campaign, confirm its products were not manually changed by a newer process.

External services

The plugin includes the Freemius SDK for optional account connection, license activation, secure delivery of Pro updates, purchases, and product analytics after consent. Free campaign processing and price history remain on the WordPress site.

When a site administrator opts in, activates a license, purchases Pro, or manages the account, Freemius may receive technical site and plugin information needed to provide those services. Users can skip the optional connection and continue using the free campaign features.

Freemius privacy policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
Freemius terms: https://freemius.com/terms/

Privacy

Campaign settings, product identifiers, before/after price values, and campaign logs are stored in the site’s own WordPress database. The optional Freemius connection is governed by the disclosure above and the consent screen shown by its SDK.

Credits

Lotusa Price Campaigns for WooCommerce is developed and maintained by Simeon Brashnenkov (WordPress.org username: lotusa01).
sections.installation:
1. Make a database backup.
  2. Upload the plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or copy the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate WooCommerce.
  4. Activate Lotusa Price Campaigns for WooCommerce.
  5. Open WooCommerce > Price Campaigns.
  6. Review the campaign scope and run the first campaign on a staging copy or after a complete backup.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin support variable products?

Yes. Each variation is processed as an individual WooCommerce product. The variable parent product is synchronized after its variations are updated.

Can I change regular prices?

Yes. The free edition can increase or decrease regular prices by percentage. You can choose whether an existing sale price should be removed.

Can I create sale prices?

Yes. Select Promotional price and enter the percentage discount to calculate from each product’s regular price.

Can I undo a campaign?

Yes. The plugin saves the old regular price, sale price, and sale dates for each successfully changed product. Use Restore / Undo in Campaign History.

Can I target selected categories or products?

Yes. Category targeting is included in Free, including parent categories and their descendants. Pro adds tags, product IDs/SKUs, attributes, stock, price ranges, and individual variation pricing.

Can Pro normalize all regular prices to .99 or .95 endings?

Yes. In Pro, select Regular / current price and choose Normalize price ending. You can round up, round down, or use the nearest .99 or .95 ending. For example, .99 + Round up changes 12.38 to 12.99 and 6.64 to 6.99.

What happens when a product has no regular price?

The product is skipped and the reason is shown in the live log.

Does uninstalling delete campaign history?

No. The database tables are intentionally preserved because their stored values may still be needed to review or restore prices.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Free: Added hierarchical product-category selection with automatic descendant selection.
  • Free: Added Load / Reload selected products workflow to prevent stale category selections.
  • Free: Added mandatory Preview Changes before a live campaign can start.
  • Free: Added selection summary for simple products, variable parents, and variations.
  • Pro: Added individual variation price overrides grouped by category and attribute.
  • Pro: Added exact regular price, exact sale price, percent discount, and fixed discount variation rules.
  • Pro: Added UTF-8/Cyrillic-safe variation slug matching (for values such as а4 and а5).
  • Pro: Advanced targeting now participates in the signed loaded-selection state.

1.0.1

  • Pro: Added Price Ending Normalization for existing regular prices.
  • Pro: Added .99 and .95 ending presets with Up, Down, and Nearest directions.
  • Pro: Normalization does not require a percentage or fixed value and remains fully reversible through campaign history.
  • Improved campaign form behavior for value-free Pro actions.

1.0.0

  • First stable public release.
  • Added safe regular and sale price campaigns.
  • Added support for simple products and variations.
  • Added AJAX batch progress, live logs, campaign history, and manual restore.
  • Added Freemius integration for optional account connection, Pro licensing, checkout, and updates.
